scope: Source records already cited by the canonical drug-page batches gained a Crossref DOI, a PubMed id, or an explicit non-DOI type. No synthesis row, grade, effect, rationale, domain judgment, or assessment date changed.
method: Compared each changed public source with the previous record. The only changed keys were doi, pmid, nonDoiSourceType, and sourceTier. Evidence input fingerprints and outcome-summary input fingerprints were then rebound with the existing compilers.
